artboards.title: Card states — not signed in · not installed
Job editor — a model switched off

annotations.text: 1 · Settings › Platforms, as this install opens after the upgrade: the two platforms in use came up enabled with the models the jobs already use. Anthropic: 4 of 5 on. OpenAI: only Luna on (the $10/$50 Astra stays off). OpenCode: found or not, nothing else until its engine ships.
2 · Overview on a fresh install: nothing is enabled, so the banner says so, New job takes you to Settings, and the Settings item carries the attention dot.

3 · The two ways a card can fail the check. Left: binary found, no session — the switch stays locked until Test passes. Right: no binary — the path field is where you point at it; it is saved when you leave the field.
4 · The job editor's Agent step: Platform lists only enabled platforms, Model lists only the models switched on in Settings, and says how many the catalog still hides.
5 · A job whose model was switched off later: the editor keeps the value, flags it, and says what happens — it never rewrites the job on its own.
